Hi Josh —

Thanks again for the chat this morning. Quick recap and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for alignment so we can keep momentum:

1) Confirmed stakeholders (please correct if I missed anyone):
   - Economic buyer / exec sponsor: Josh Bennett (you)
   - Security lead: Nina Park (nina.park@finpay.com)
   - Procurement: procurement@finpay.com
   - Legal / contract owner: (TBD — if you can share a contact that helps)

2) Decision criteria you highlighted: latency under 200ms median, data isolation for payments PII, predictable cost model for 10M tokens/month, SOC 2 plus attestations.

3) Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
   - POC scope & plan shared (this week) — owner: Redwood (Aditya) — deliverable: POC checklist + infra runbook
   - Security questionnaire & evidence (2 weeks) — owner: FinPay (Nina) + Redwood support
   - Procurement & SOW review (3 weeks) — owner: Procurement / Legal
   - Exec review & sign-off (4–5 weeks) — owner: Josh / FinPay execs

I attached a first-pass stakeholder map (FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short POC checklist to make the POC kickoff easy. Proposed POC kickoff window: Mar 15–17.

Can you confirm the stakeholder list and whether those dates work? If there's a procurement or legal contact I should loop in, please introduce them and I will own the MAP doc updates.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

--
Camila Reyes

Thanks, Camila. Attached is an updated MAP spreadsheet (FinPay_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOW draft (SOW_Draft.pdf) for procurement to review. Highlights from the POC checklist / runbook:

- POC kickoff: proposed Mar 15 (flex to Mar 17) — owner: Redwood

- Deliverables: perf run (latency/cost), security evidence packet (SOC 2 checklist + arch sketch), integration guide
- Architecture: using customer VPC peering + Redwood private deployment for request routing. KMS integration described (customer-managed keys supported).
- Test plan: 3 test scenarios (baseline gen, burst load, long-context) and expected pass criteria.

Please review the attached MAP and SOW; Josh / Nina if you can confirm the security contacts and procurement timelines we will lock dates.

Next steps I propose:
1) Camila to confirm legal contact (Laura) and loop her into the MAP.
2) FinPay to confirm POC kickoff date (Mar 15 vs Mar 17).
3) Aditya to deliver final runbook and architecture sketch by Mar 9.
